meaning.zh:
“超越自我” 或 “超越之前的水平”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到竞赛或成就的概念，意思是一个人超过了自己以前的成绩或水平。在日常生活中，当一个人做出了比他们之前更好的成绩或表现时，就可以使用这个表达。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the concept of competition or achievement, meaning that a person has surpassed their previous accomplishments or level of performance. In everyday life, this expression is used when someone performs better than they did before.

lines.en: She really outdid herself with this year’s presentation.
lines.zh: 她今年的演示真的超越了自我。

lines.en: He always tries to outdo himself every year with his holiday decorations.
lines.zh: 他每年都力图在假日装饰上超越自我。

lines.en: With this new project, our team has truly outdone themselves.
lines.zh: 通过这个新项目，我们的团队真的超越了之前的水平。
